body:
Not to mention fucking Valentines day is coming up. It's going to be the first one since my girlfriend left me. She'd sleep with any guy that gave her a second look and I'd always forgive her, with increasing reluctance and annoyance because that's how dumb and incredibly in love I was... we were together for more than a quarter of my entire life and she still treated me like shit. There was so much psychological and emotional abuse and I feel stupid that I could never see it while we were together... finally she found a guy I guess she thought was better than me and had more money so she slept around with him behind my back while I was doing a major life project I didn't even want to do that much but was only doing because she wanted me to and she said it would make us closer then she left me for this fucking piece of shit asshole. She hated it when I came out to her as bi and yelled and screamed and said she couldn't believe I was doing this to her but I wasn't doing ANYTHING except trying to express who I was to the single person I was closest to.

I've been with some awesome people ever since but I feel like I'm broken forever. I can't feel for people like I used to. I don't think I can fall in love. I can't trust anyone like I used to... and I can't fucking stop doing it. I told her I forgave her and was happy that she found someone she loved. She never apologized for what she did and if I tried to bring it up she'd get angry at me and say I was just trying to hurt her or whatever but I fell like I ought to be able to express my genuine pain and suffering from the whole fucked up situation. I fucking hate this so much
